reviews.text: Nadine does an incredible job making our dog look as handsome as the day he was born. Nadine is very professional, has a calming influence on dogs and owners and so easy to deal with. She's a true professional who cares about her dogs and her customer's experience.
Nadine is wonderful and very patient with our reactive dog - Gary. He looks and smells amazing after every visit, we are very lucky to have Nadine in our lives.

We have been using Nadine for a few years now. She is the nicest person and her grooming skills are excellent. She is so thorough and really quick at getting back to you RE appointments. Highly recommend! 🌟 …
Delighted to have found Nadine, she is such a lovely person and takes good care of my poodle! Wouldn't go anywhere else 💜 …

Nadine is a fabulous Groomer. We have a very large black lab who is quite lively and mischievous at times and Nadine looks after him so well. His michieviousness or size doesnt phase her and he gets really excited when we tell him he is going down to see Nadine as he absolutely adores her. Nadine is super friendly with us when we drop and collect Dougie and does a fantastic job with his groom every time. Amazing and would recommend to everyone

So fetch is THE BEST groomers ever!! Nadine is just amazing - from start to finish! I cannot recommend her enough!  Our dog Ted actually loves going and getting his hair done, she is so kind and so amazing with the dogs and ontop of it all she is just a lovely lovely person!

Nadine is amazing at what she does. She clearly adores all the dogs and Lucy always comes away looking so good. She knows Lucy doesn't love all dogs so makes sure not to overlap her appts which we appreciate so much.
Couldn't recommend Nadine enough

Nadine is absolutely fantastic! Rubble always comes back looking and smelling divine, and he’s clearly so happy after his visits. You can tell he’s really well cared for every time! Highly recommend So Fetch!
Great dog groomer!! Brought my pug to her and he came back looking brilliant. Really professional and polite service you can’t go wrong. Worth every penny!!
This is a lovely place to get your dog groomed   Nadine was brilliant
Nadine always has my two cocker spaniels looking amazing after their groom. She is so lovely and gentle with them which makes the entire experience so smooth. 100% recommend!
The best dog groomer I have found. Nadine is amazing and you can tell she loves each and every dog that comes into her. Well priced and she always does a fab job on my Golden Retriever. He loves her!
Nadine does such an amazing job on my two Golden Retrievers. Nadine is so nice and amazing at what she does. Would recommend Nadine to anyone!
Nadine takes all the time in the world to get to know the dogs. Ours always comes out happy and smelling delicious

We are so lucky to have Nadine as our groomer and couldn’t recommend So Fetch highly enough! Nadine is incredibly caring and has a true passion for what she does. We completely trust Nadine and Maisy feels very comfortable and happy in her care x

Chloe & Maisy xx

Couldn’t have found a better groomer for my Goldendoodle Penny! 🐶 Nadine puts so much time and effort into every dog she grooms and genuinely cares for every dog! Penny always looks amazing after being with her! …
Absolutely fabulous grooming studio. Nadine is always so meticulous when grooming and my dog leaves looking and feeling fantastic! Great value for money, excellent customer service & communication.
Nadine is very good with nervous dogs. Our boy comes out happy, looking his best and smelling amazing every time.
